description: Create, update, or delete GitLab groups/namespaces. Actions: create (new group with visibility/settings), update (modify group settings, including automatic GitLab Duo code review cascading to subgroups and projects; a Duo setting GitLab could not apply is listed in not_applied with what it requires), delete (remove permanently), restore (recover a soft-deleted group before purge; on GitLab Free needs 18.0+). Related: browse_namespaces for discovery.

action.description: Action to perform: create, update, delete, restore

allowed_email_domains_list.description: Premium+: comma-separated email domains allowed for group membership. Required for 'update' action(s).

auto_duo_code_review_enabled.description: Premium+: run GitLab Duo code review automatically on merge requests in this group, cascading to its subgroups and projects. Needs a Duo Enterprise add-on or Duo Agent Platform code review; reported in `not_applied` when GitLab skips it. Required for 'update' action(s).

avatar.description: Group avatar URL. Required for 'create' action(s).

default_branch_protection.description: Branch protection level: 0=none, 1=partial, 2=full. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

description.description: New group description. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

group_id.description: Group ID or URL-encoded path of the group to restore. Required for 'update', 'delete', 'restore' action(s).

ip_restriction_ranges.description: Premium+: comma-separated CIDR ranges that may access the group. Required for 'update' action(s).

lfs_enabled.description: Enable Git LFS. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

membership_lock.description: Premium+: prevent members from being added directly to projects in this group. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

name.description: Group display name. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

parent_id.description: Parent group ID for subgroup. Required for 'create' action(s).

path.description: Group path for URLs (URL-safe). Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

request_access_enabled.description: Allow access requests. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

unique_project_download_limit.description: Ultimate: max unique project downloads per user before action is taken. Required for 'update' action(s).

visibility.description: Group visibility level. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

wiki_access_level.description: Premium+: group wiki access level. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

name: manage_namespace
